workstream: a gate for the mistake p260 found: rules naming target members that do not exist
why: 1.21.4 renamed Registry#registryKey from method_30517 to method_46765; the 1.21.4 rule still said method_30517 and every bytecode assertion passed, because patch emits calls without checking the callee exists

whatIsInspected.precision: reads the target class's declaration tables, so (name, descriptor) must match exactly; a same-named overload does not count as present

notInDefaultGates: it needs work/target/client-1.21.4-intermediary.jar, which is not committed; wiring it into release_check would fail on a clean checkout
scope: tool + evidence only, no conversion; the negative case is a synthetic copy of the rule with the old name
